title: The Day Rate the Days Are Charged At on Longer Equipment Rental and Demo Agreements
content:
A week of hire is sold as a week and several days of hire are sold as several days, so the day rate an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement's days are charged at follows how long the agreement runs.

## The rule

Where the agreement runs for seven days or more, and the package's weekly rate is lower than seven days at the package's multi-day day rate, every day is charged at a seventh of the package's weekly rate, rounded half up to two decimal places.

Where the agreement runs for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, and is not a seven-day block priced below at the weekly rate, every day is charged at the package's multi-day day rate.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the day rate.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Multi-day threshold, days | Multi-day day rate | Full seven-day block | Seven days at the multi-day day rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 27.00 USD | 169.00 USD | 189.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 39.00 USD | 245.00 USD | 273.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 53.00 USD | 329.00 USD | 371.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 68.00 USD | 419.00 USD | 476.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 82.00 USD | 509.00 USD | 574.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 1 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

The last column is the fourth column's figure taken seven times, and it is what the weekly rate is measured against.

## The two branches on a hypothetical agreement

Take the Sport Ski & Board Rental, whose threshold is 3 days, whose multi-day day rate is 53.00 USD and whose weekly rate is 329.00 USD.

- The agreement runs for 9 days. Nine days is seven days or more, and 329.00 USD is lower than 371.00 USD, so every day is charged at a seventh of 329.00 USD, which is 47.00 USD.
- The agreement runs for 5 days. Five days is fewer than seven, and it is at least the threshold of 3, so every day is charged at 53.00 USD.
- The agreement runs for 2 days. Two days is fewer than the threshold of 3, so nothing under this heading changes the day rate.

On the Junior Ski & Board Rental a seventh of the weekly rate of 169.00 USD is 24.14 USD once rounded half up to two decimal places; on the Performance Ski & Board Rental a seventh of 419.00 USD is 59.86 USD.

## Point of judgement

**Which of the two comes first.** An agreement of seven days or more on a package whose weekly rate is lower than seven days at its multi-day day rate is charged at the seventh of the weekly rate; the multi-day day rate is what the remaining agreements of at least the threshold are charged at.
